cases.sentence: Или, например, декрет о земле: передать народу всю землю уезда, со всеми угодьями и со всякой движимостью, со всеми ___ и без всякого выкупа.
cases.explain: «спиртными напитками» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Or, for example, a decree concerning land: transferring to the people all the land in the district, all acreage and all movable property, along with all alcoholic beverages and without any requital? Or this: resetting the hands of the clock two hours forward or an hour and a half back, or any way whatever. Then demanding that the word "‘devil" be spelled with a capital D, or cancelling some letter altogether—it’s just a question of which one. And, finally, forcing Aunty Masha in Andreevo to open her store at five-thirty instead of nine.

cases.sentence: А речь вот о чем: если ты ___, садись и пиши декреты.
cases.explain: «хороший канцлер» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: ‘That's not the point, Vadya. The point is this: if you’re a decent counselor, sit down and write decrees. Have another little drink, sit down and write. I heard that you have not restrained yourself after all, that you pinched Anatole Ivanych’s thigh. What are you up to? You want to Start a terror campaign?"

cases.sentence: Ты у меня ___, Вадя, а это хорошо.
cases.explain: «блестящий теоретик» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: ‘You put it correctly, we'll leave it as is. In youl have a brilliant theoretician, Vadya, and that’s good. Should we close the Plenum or not? Aunty Shura in Polomy is already open. She has some Rossiiskaya, they say."’

cases.sentence: У тети Шуры в Поломах в ___ оказалась российская.
cases.explain: «самом деле» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Aunty Shura in Polomy really did have some Rossiis- kaya. In connection with this, as well as in expectation of punitive raids from the Regional Center, it was decided to move the capital temporarily from Cherkasovo to Polomy—that is, twelve versts deeper into the territory of the Republic.

cases.sentence: В связи с этим, а также в ожидании ___ из райцентра решено было временно перенести столицу из Черкасова в Поломы, то есть на двенадцать верст вглубь территории республики.
cases.explain: «карательных набегов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Aunty Shura in Polomy really did have some Rossiis- kaya. In connection with this, as well as in expectation of punitive raids from the Regional Center, it was decided to move the capital temporarily from Cherkasovo to Polomy—that is, twelve versts deeper into the territory of the Republic.

cases.sentence: – Я встаю с ___, – сказал я в своем выступлении, – я плюю в президентское кресло.
cases.explain: «президентского кресла» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: "T am getting up from the President’s chair," I said. "I spit in the President’s chair. I feel that the President's chair should be occupied by someone who looks so shot from drink that you couldn't touch his face with a three- day beating. Do we actually have anyone like that?" "We don't," the delegates answered in unison. "Take me, for example, couldn't you touch mine with a three-day beat- ing?"

cases.sentence: Мою речь прервали овации, и Пленум прикрылся: ___ озарились синим огнем.
cases.explain: «окрестные луга» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: My speech was interrupted by an ovation, and the Plenum was closed down. The neighboring meadows lit up with the blue fire of the stills. I alone did not share the general animation and optimism. I moved from fire to fire with a single alarming thought: why wasn’t anyone in the world willing to have anything to do with us? Why such silence in the world? The district is in flames, and the world is silent because it is holding its breath, perhaps, but why has no one extended his hand—not from the east, not from the west? What’s become of King Olaf? Why don't regular units crush us from the south?

cases.sentence: Один только я не разделял ___ и веры в успех, я ходил меж огней с одною тревожною мыслью: почему это никому в мире нет до нас ни малейшего дела?
cases.explain: «всеобщего оживления» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.

Why such silence in the world? The district is in flames, and the world is silent because it is holding its breath, perhaps, but why has no one extended his hand—not from the east, not from the west? What’s become of King Olaf? Why don't regular units crush us from the south?
